scope: Teacher counts are oracle controls, unavailable during deployment. Interventions are not an additive error partition.

methods.deployed: Original saved model and all predicted budgets
methods.oracle_final_budget: Original deployed latent, exact teacher count at final projection only
methods.oracle_recursive_budget: All frozen-base and final budgets replaced by exact teacher count; weights fixed, latents recomputed
methods.teacher_predicted_budget: Teacher field projected to original predicted count; budget-only counterfactual, weighted-MSE lower bound only for capacity_l2
